On the wall behind the side table, a grid of four small framed botanical prints in gilded frames creates a composed gallery moment. A gentle, warm glow radiates softly from floor level between the chaise and side table, illuminating the surrounding floor and the lower wall surfaces, wrapping the velvety surfaces of the chaise in a rosy warmth — all of the light emanates at floor height and below. The palette combines dusty rose, warm cream, dark walnut brown, and natural biscuit, creating an intimate, romantic atmosphere.
